name: paymydine-cashier-desktop
description: PayMyDine Cashier real desktop app: locally bundled POS UI, durable local cache and drafts, canonical cloud sync, secure payments, printer and cash drawer support.

scripts.check: node --check src/real-app-main.js && node --check src/local-store.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/setup.js && node --check src/hardware.js && node --check src/receipt.js && node --check src/hardware-page.js && node --check src/offline.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run check && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run check && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
